description: Source code for the TouchButtonAccumulator class, handling touch and stylus button events in Android input system.

classes.name: TouchButtonAccumulator
classes.description: Class responsible for accumulating and processing touch and stylus button events.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the accumulator by checking available scan codes for touch and stylus.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets button states based on current device key presses.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes raw input events, updating button states accordingly.

methods.name: processMappedKey
methods.description: Handles mapped key codes for stylus buttons.

methods.name: getButtonState
methods.description: Returns the current button state as a bitmask.

methods.name: getToolType
methods.description: Determines the tool type (e.g., mouse, eraser, stylus, finger) based on active buttons.

methods.name: isToolActive
methods.description: Checks if any tool-related button is active.

methods.name: isHovering
methods.description: Indicates if the device is hovering (touch not active).

methods.name: hasButtonTouch
methods.description: Checks if touch button is available.

methods.name: getTouchCount
methods.description: Returns the number of touches based on button states.
